name: scandock-wms
description: ScanDock WMS - a toy mobile barcode warehouse system (receiving, picking, shipping, transfers, cycle counts) with an ERP sync layer, built to practice end-to-end QA automation with Playwright.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n db,erp,api,web -c blue,magenta,green,yellow "docker compose up db" "npm run dev -w apps/erp-mock" "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.test:unit: npm run test -w apps/api && npm run test -w apps/web
scripts.up: docker compose up -d --build db erp-mock api web
scripts.logs: docker compose logs -f api web erp-mock
